title: {Syn} Bloom Filters Trade Certainty for Tiny Memory
content:
A Bloom filter can say that an item is definitely not present or possibly present. False positives are possible; false negatives are not, assuming no deletions in the basic structure.

That one-sided uncertainty is useful in caches, databases, and network systems where a compact precheck saves expensive lookups.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
